texts.J’ai effectué mon Bachelor universitaire: I completed my Bachelor of Technology through an apprenticeship at PRST Group. I learned to create electrical schematics, wire equipment and program control systems, following projects through to testing. I also discovered how rewarding it is to work with a supportive team, where I could ask questions and share ideas. Their guidance helped me become more confident and independent.
texts.Il y a un an et demi, j’ai rejoint EDF p: A year and a half ago, I joined EDF to pursue my engineering degree through an apprenticeship. In the Telecommunications and Telecontrol team, I am learning how equipment, networks and supervision work together in electrical installations. Setting up a test platform and modelling high-voltage substations helps me develop my skills through practical projects.
